# Summary and questions

# Phase gate learning

:::{#def-phasegate-learn .callout-note icon="false"}
Inputs: A black-box unitary $U \ket{s} = e^{i\phi(s)} \ket{s}$, where $\phi(s)$ is a degree-$k$ polynomial of $s \in \{-1,1\}^{n} \to \mathbb{R}$ such that:
$$
\phi(s) = \sum_{S \subseteq [n],|S| \le k} a_S \prod_{t \in S} s_t, \quad a_S \in \mathbb{R}
$$

Ensure: Approximates $a_S \in \mathbb{R}, \forall |S| \le k$ within additive error $\varepsilon$.
:::
